seasons.name: The Ancient Tea Horse Road Season
The Heavenly Road
seasons.overview:
The program focuses on high-altitude regions for the first time, using Tibet’s Nyingchi (elevation 2,900–4,768 meters), Lake Namtso, the Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon, and the Pamir Plateau in Xinjiang as its main filming locations. Through a “self-drive + camping” format, the team explores sites along National Highway 318, integrating Tibetan intangible cultural heritage—such as thangka painting and Tibetan incense making—with magnificent natural landscapes including snow-capped mountains and deep canyons.

The wishes have already been made in advance—now we’re just waiting to tell them to the snowy peaks! A new journey is about to begin. Let’s look forward to it together!
